ContentId.description: A content item's id in the site's content repository (spec 3.5 §7.8.2).

Proof.description:
A detached JWS (spec 3.5 §7.2).

`jws` is the compact serialization with an empty payload; the signed payload is the JCS
form of the enclosing document without its `proof`.

kid.description: Key id of the signing key in `keys.json`.

description:
One entry of a stream — a live blog, a ticker, an emergency update — signed by the edge
with a delegated `receipt` key and folded into a signed release (spec 3.5 §7.8.3).

corrects.description: The number of an entry it corrects.

n.description: The entry's number in the stream, from 1 without gaps.

proof.description: The edge's detached JWS over the JCS form of the entry without `proof`.

stream.description: The content item the stream belongs to.

title: StreamEntry
